row.body: A shift pack is tied to the store key and a route card; the cashier’s sign-out is stamped before the delivery van’s return.
row.title: The shift pack

sidecar.gloss: A cashier signs out before the delivery van returns.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could carry supplies and return the van later; the card does not show who authorized the schedule.

row.body: the pipe wrench and seed sack are packed with treated seed. every kernel has the same cracked green coating.
row.title: field residue on the pipe wrench

sidecar.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
